archetype: Swiss Brutalist mixed with Luxury Ops (Mission Control)

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' for technical data (Registry, Change Lab). Use 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10) for Aurora and floating overlays.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Avoid generic drop shadows. Use glowing halos (box-shadow) for active nodes/twins.
visual_enhancers.animations: Nodes breathe using Framer Motion (scale/opacity pulses). Edges flow using CSS stroke-dashoffset.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8) around main sections, dense spacing (p-2, gap-2) inside data tables/lists.
layouts.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. High density for dashboards. No centered default layouts.

radar.description: Page d'accueil. Flux priorisé de situations, not a KPI dashboard.
radar.components: Cardless list items with bottom borders, rich metadata. Quick actions on hover: Examiner, Créer, Ignorer, Surveiller.

zones.question: col-span-12 (Large Chivo heading).
zones.hypotheses: col-span-8 (Grid of evidence pro/con with trust indicators).
zones.conclusion: col-span-12 (Distinct surface for Aurora synthesis and human decision).

change_lab.layout: Split view. Controls on left, results/table on right.
change_lab.components: Tableau Risque/Effort/Compatibilité, Visual impact radius (mini map).

system_map.layout: Full screen absolute canvas with floating UI panels on top.
system_map.features: Stable domain positioning (mémoire spatiale), significant movement only. Active relation flows, temporary halos for events.

registry.components: Shadcn Table, Stepper for 5-step admission (Déclarer -> Connecter -> Observer -> Examiner -> Admettre).

aurora.styling: Glassmorphism, fixed bottom center or floating contextually. Prescripted simulated responses with Twin Contributions and Evidence.

trust_indicators.description: Four indicators present on all conclusions and hypotheses.

libraries.system_map: reactflow (Best for stable layouts, custom React nodes, animated SVG edges)

demo_flow.name: Parcours Olympiade (7 actes)
steps: Décision (action proposée, rayon d'impact Change Lab)

background_elements.description: 3D geometric network structure. Use at 5-10% opacity as a background texture for the map loading state or empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI entirely in French.
Do NOT build a generic SaaS dashboard. The aesthetic is 'Ops Intelligence / Mission Control' - dark, technical, dense, and precise.
System Map must be implemented using 'reactflow'. Nodes must be custom components with pulsing animations for 'vivant' effect.
Aurora is not a chat page; it is a floating command bar component.
Pre-load the application with the 'Jeu de données de démonstration riche' (Paiements, Comptes, Fraude, Support) to support the Olympiade demo.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds behind text; use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur + bg-opacity) for overlays.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always include 'data-testid' attributes in kebab-case on all interactive and key informational elements (e.g. data-testid='radar-item-1').
Do not center-align the app container. Text should flow naturally (left-aligned for data and reading).
Create depth with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
Never apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly animate specific properties.
Do not use AI emojis for icons. Use the specified icon library (@phosphor-icons/react).
Ensure all contrast ratios pass accessibility standards, especially in dark mode.
